frases: You closed the month very well! 🎉 Money left over, you controlled spending, and even managed to save. Keep it up!
Excellent month! 🔥 You did great on almost everything. Keep going and next month will be even better.
Way to go! ✨ This month was a breather for your wallet and you still had money left to save.
Nice! Your month was positive 😄 You kept good control and stayed within expectations in most categories.
Positive month! 👏 You balanced income and expenses and still closed in the black.
Well done! 💪 Quiet month, no excess, and the balance stayed positive.
It was an okay month 🙂 Things didn't get totally out of control, but you can adjust a few points to save more next time.
This month was balanced, not too bad, not too great 😅
Average month 🤔 You managed to close it, but you can tighten some expenses to have more left over.
Oops! This month needed more care ⚠️ Your spending went past the ideal in some areas.
Whoa, this month got a little out of control 👀 It's worth looking at the categories that grew the most.
Attention! 🚧 Some categories went over budget and the balance got tight. Let's reorganize for next month.
Alert on 🚨 This month weighed more on your wallet. It's worth reviewing categories and bills so next month closes better.
This month was tough 😬 More outflow than income and several areas bursting — time to breathe and replan.
Critical month 🚨 Important to review where you can cut back before the next one rolls around.
